verdict.rationale: Typesense's own docs say it combines typo-tolerant keyword search with direct vector, hybrid and semantic search. The official GitHub repo links a live semantic/hybrid search demo over 300K HN comments, and the guide has a Semantic Search section. The evidence covers hybrid search clearly but only at the level of claims and headings. Missing for 10: in-depth docs showing how vector and keyword scores are fused within a single query (e.g. query parameters, fusion or weighting controls), and independent or hands-on confirmation of hybrid relevance.
